title: Efficient Generation and Editing of Feeder-free IPSCs from Human Pancreatic Cells Using the CRISPR-Cas9 System
protocol: Coat a 6-well plate with 1.5 mg/mL cold collagen.
Allow the coated plate to gel at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Plate early passage human primary pancreatic cells in Prigrow III medium (~1 - 1.5 × 10^5 cells) on a collagen-coated 6-well plate on day -2.
Achieve approximately 2.5 × 10^5 cells or at least 60% confluency per well on the day of transduction (day 0).
Plate at least 2 - 3 wells to get one well with desired confluency on day 0 for the first study.
Use at least one well as a control to count the cells.
Warm 1 mL of Prigrow III medium in a water bath for each well to be transduced on the day of transduction (day 0).
Harvest the cells from one control well in 1 mL of 10% FBS medium using 1 mL of trypsin/EDTA for 5 min or till the cells detach.
Perform a cell count after detaching the cells.
To make 10% FBS medium, add DMEM, 10% FBS, 1% L-Glutamine, 1% Sodium Pyruvate, and 1% non-essential amino acids.
Count and check the viability of the cells using the cell counter.
Calculate the volume of each virus needed based on cell number and virus titer.
Thaw one set of Sendai vector tubes in ice from -80 °C storage.
Add calculated volumes of KOS, hc-Myc, and hKlf4 vectors to 1 mL of pre-warmed Prigrow III medium.
Pipette gently to mix the solution containing reprogramming virus mixture.
Aspirate Prigrow III medium from cells in a 6-well plate.
Slowly add reprogramming virus mixture to the wells containing the cells.
Incubate cells overnight at 37 °C with humidified atmosphere of 5% CO2.
Discard virus mixture on cells and replace with fresh Prigow III medium the next day, 24 h after transduction.
Culture cells for 5 days, changing medium every alternate day.
On day 5, prepare MEFs on 0.1% gelatin pre-coated 10 cm culture dishes.
Grow MEFs in T175 flasks until day 4.
Expose cells to 6,000 rads from a γ-radiation source before seeding the cells or use commercial MEF source.
Use 1 mL of cell detachment solution to detach the transduced cells for 10 min.
Plate all detached cells on MEF dishes in Prigrow III medium with rock inhibitor (5 mM stock, 10 µM final).
Incubate overnight in a 37 °C incubator with a humidified atmosphere of 5% CO2.
Change the Prigow III medium to hESC medium the next day.
For making 500 mL of hESC medium, add DMEM/F-12, 20% (v/v) knockout serum replacement (KOSR), 5 ng/mL bFGF; 1 mM l-glutamine; 100 µM nonessential amino acids and 100 µM 2-mercaptoethanol.
Change the medium gently every day.
Observe plates regularly for cell clumps or colonies indicative of reprogrammed cells.
Mark probable 'iPSC' colonies and check them regularly for growth.
Prepare 24-well MEF plates by plating 1.3 x 10^6 cells/gelatin pre-coated plate as before for the transfer of single colonies.
Aliquot matrix membrane (e.g., Matrigel) based on the dilution factor on the certificate of analysis.
Add one aliquot to 25 mL of DMEM/F-12 to coat four 6-well plates (1 mL/well).
Incubate at room temperature for at least 1 h before use.
Manually pick 12-24 colonies using a sterile pipette-tip to aspirate them.
Transfer picked colonies onto MEF plates in 500 µL of hESC medium.
Aspirate the media in the well to gently disrupt or break apart the colonies.
Pick 24-48 colonies on matrix membrane coated 24-well plates.
Use mTeSR1 (supplemented with 10 µM rock inhibitor) for 24 h and change every day.
Transfer colonies to new 24-well and/or 12-well membrane plates within 6-10 days of picking.
Detach the colonies on MEFs using 1 mg/mL collagenase for 20 min.
Wash twice with hESC/mTeSR1 before transferring to membrane coated 12- or 24-well plates.
Freeze robust colonies on MEFs using iPSC freezing media as per manufacturer's guidelines.
Detach robust colonies plated on the membrane using 500 µL of dispase for 20 min.
Plate detached colonies again on matrix membrane coated 12-well plates.
Manually scrape off any differentiated cells or contaminating MEF feeder cells to enrich for pluripotent clones.
Expand clones after 6-8 days on membrane-coated plates by dissociating with dispase solution.
Plate small cell aggregates on fresh membrane-coated 6- or 12-well plates.
Change mTeSR1 medium daily for the cells grown on membrane-coated plates.
Characterize reprogrammed clones by alkaline phosphatase staining.
Aspirate culture medium and wash cells with 1 mL of 1x PBS containing 0.05% Tween 20 (PBST).
Add 0.5 mL of fix solution from the kit to the cells and incubate at room temperature for 2 to 5 minutes.
Aspirate the fix solution and then wash fixed cells with PBST, ensuring wells do not dry.
Add 0.5 mL of freshly prepared AP Substrate Solution per well by mixing solutions A, B, and C from the kit.
Incubate the cells in the dark at room temperature for 5 to 15 minutes.
Plate human iPSCs in 24-well plate and culture for 4-5 days with daily media change.
Wash cells once briefly with PBS.
Fix cells for 20 min with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS.
Wash three times for 10 min each with PBS at room temperature.
Saturate non-specific sites with 10% normal goat or donkey serum (NS, depending on the animal secondary antibody was raised in) in PBS for 40 min at room temperature.
For intracellular epitopes, include 0.3% TX-100 in PBS to permeabilize.
Wash three times for 5 min each with PBS at room temperature.
Dilute OCT4, NANOG, TUJ1, NKX2-5 and SOX17 antibodies in a fresh solution of 5% NS in PBS and incubate for 2 h at room temperature or overnight at 4 °C.
Wash three times for 5 min each with PBS at room temperature.
Dilute appropriate secondary Alexa Fluor 488 or 568 antibodies in 5% NS/PBS and incubate cells for 1 h at room temperature.
Wash three times for 5 min each with PBS at room temperature.
Incubate with DAPI in PBS for 10 min.
Wash two times for 5 min each with PBS at room temperature.
Use a fluorescent microscope to take pictures.
Plate human iPSCs in a 6-well plate.
Culture the colonies until they become 80% confluent, changing the mTeSR1 medium daily.
Isolate and dissociate cells to a single cell suspension on the day of the experiment.
Wash isolated cells with 10% FBS medium.
Resuspend surface marker samples in 0.5-1 mL of 10% FBS medium and keep on ice.
Incubate intracellular marker samples in 1 mL of 4% PFA/PBS for 10 min at room temperature.
Wash incubated cells with 10% FBS medium.
Resuspend in 0.1% TX/PBS and incubate for 15 min on ice.
Wash again with 10% FBS medium.
Resuspend in 0.5-1 mL of 10% FBS medium and keep on ice.
Add 50 µL of cell suspension to 50 µL of 10% FBS medium containing the recommended amount of TRA-1-60, TRA-1-81 or SSEA-4 antibodies.
Incubate for 30 min to 1 h.
Wash twice with 10% FBS medium.
Resuspend in 100 µL of 10% FBS medium containing fluorescent secondary antibodies and incubate for 30 min.
Wash twice with 10% FBS medium.
Resuspend in an appropriate volume of 10% FBS.
Add propidium iodide dye at <1 µg/mL to estimate cell apoptosis.
Seed two 6-well plates with 1.5-2 x 10^6 iPSCs/well in mTeSR1 medium with 10 µM rock inhibitor.
Allow cells to grow for 2-3 d, changing the mTeSR1 medium daily until wells are 80-90% confluent.
Add neural induction medium (NIM) according to the manufacturer's instructions in 2-3 wells of the 6-well plates.
Change the medium to RPMI containing 2% B27 supplement minus insulin and 12 µM CHIR99021 for mesoderm induction in 2-3 wells of the plates.
Add only RPMI containing 2% B27 supplement minus insulin for the next 24 h.
Add 5 µM IWP4 to the RPMI medium with 2% B27 supplement minus insulin for the next 24 h.
Replace the media with RPMI containing 2% B27 supplement after 72 h leading to the generation of beating cardiomyocytes in 2-3 days.

Change the medium in wells of the 6-well plates to MCDB 131 supplemented with 1.5 g/L sodium bicarbonate, 1x Glutamax, 10 mM glucose, 0.5% BSA, 100 ng/mL GDF8, and 5 µM CHIR99021 for endoderm induction.
Culture in the same medium without CHIR99021 for 2-3 days.
Follow the immunostaining protocol from step 2 for all three lineages to check for the expression of relevant markers.
Aliquot Cas9 protein into microcentrifuge tubes in sterile conditions.
Store the aliquots by freezing the tubes at -80°C.
Design two targeting guide RNAs for each gene based on CRISPR guide design webtools.
Target the first or second exon of the gene to generate knockouts.
Choose guides that cut close together (~30-100 bp apart) for easy visualization using screening primers.
Select guides with higher quality scores and fewer off-target sites.
Design screening primers at least 100 bp away from Cas9 cut sites, aiming for PCR product sizes between 400-700 bp.
Synthesize two complementary sgRNA oligo DNAs (19-22 nucleotides in length) with Bsa1 cut sites at each end.
Prepare annealing buffer: add 1 µL of 100 µM guide, 25 µL of annealing buffer, and 23 µL of water to a total volume of 50 µL.
Incubate the mixture in a thermocycler starting at 95 °C for 2 min, then gradually cooling to 25 °C over 45 min.
Digest 1 µL of T7 promoter pCR2.1 vector with Bsa1 restriction enzyme as per manufacturer's protocol.
Add 2 µL of the annealed sgRNA fragment and ligate it into the digested vector using T4 DNA ligase according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Sequence cloned DNA fragments to establish fidelity.
In vitro transcribe clones using a T7 kit to generate single guide RNAs.
Purify sgRNAs with a commercial kit and elute in RNase-free water.
Check RNA concentration.
Culture hiPSCs in mTeSR1 medium until cells are 40-50% confluent.
Replace medium with 2 mL prewarmed mTeSR1 medium containing 10 µM rock inhibitor two hours before nucleofection.
Aspirate membrane from 12-well plate and replace with prewarmed 1 mL of mTeSR1 medium with 10 µM rock inhibitor one hour later.
Prepare nucleofection master mix by adding 16.4 µL P3 primary cell supplement, 3.6 µL Supplement 1, 0.5 µg Cas9 protein, and 0.5 µg of each sgRNA in 22 µL per reaction volume.
Nucleofect pMAX GFP vector as recommended by the manufacturer to estimate transfection efficiency.
Wash each well with 2 mL RT PBS after aspirating medium from iPSC wells.
Aspirate PBS, add 1 mL cell detachment solution, and incubate plate at 37 °C for 10 min.
Resuspend the cells in 3 mL of mTeSR1 medium.
Gently pipette up and down to generate a single-cell suspension.
Transfer dissociated cells to a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing 5 mL mTeSR1 medium.
Count cells with cell counter.
Calculate total volume required for 0.5 x 106 cells/transfection.
Place desired quantity of cells in 15-mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 200 x g for 5 min at RT.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend each unit of 0.5 x 106 cells in 22 µL of the transfection master mix.
Quickly transfer cells into the central chamber of one well of a nucleocuvette strip.
Place the strip into a nucleofector device.
Nucleofect cells using program CB150.
After nucleofection, quickly add 80 µL of prewarmed mTeSR1 medium containing 10 µM rock inhibitor to each well of the nucleofected cells.
Gently mix by pipetting up and down.
Gently transfer cells from the strip to wells of the membrane pre-coated 12-well plate containing mTeSR1 medium with rock inhibitor.
After 1 day, change to fresh mTeSR1 medium without rock inhibitor.
Harvest cells 2-3 days after nucleofection for single-cell sorting.
Change the medium to hESC medium supplemented with 100 ng/mL bFGF, 1x SMC4, and 5 mg/mL fibronectin.
Replace the medium on hiPSCs in the 12-well plate from mTeSR1 to mTeSR1 medium supplemented with 1x SMC4 for at least 2 h before single cell sorting.
Aspirate the medium from hiPSCs and wash cells gently with PBS.
Add 500 μL of cell detachment solution in each well and incubate at 37 °C for 10 min after aspirating the PBS.
Generate a single-cell suspension by adding 1 mL of mTeSR1 to each well and pipetting up and down several times.
Place the cell suspension in a 15-mL conical tube and centrifuge for 5 min at 200 x g at RT.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 mL of mTeSR1.
Sort cells in single cells using a cell sorter with 100 μm nozzle under sterile conditions with one cell in the individual well of the 96-well plates prepared in step 1.
Replace the culture medium with hESC medium supplemented with 1x SMC4 four days after sorting.
Replace medium with hESC medium and culture for 2 days.
Detach colonies using 1 mg/mL collagenase for 20 minutes.
Transfer detached colonies to 24-well membrane coated plates in mTeSR1 with rock inhibitor.
Let single-cell clones grow.
Extract genomic DNA from grown clones after duplication or expansion.
Amplify target DNA by PCR using gene-specific primers.
Screen PCR-amplified target genomic region of all clones using a fragment analyzer kit according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Estimate resulting fragment size in PROSize software by comparing with an appropriate ladder.
Sequence expected 'edited' clones and analyze sequencing data to confirm editing or deletions.
Amplify edited sequence with PCR and clone in pJET1.2 vector for differentiating monoallelic and biallelic clones.
Send at least 8-10 clones for sequencing.
Check sequences to confirm editing in one or both alleles.
Examine successfully targeted iPSC clones through genotyping to confirm that they have not lost pluripotency or gained chromosomal abnormalities.
